overestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell overestimation.

symmetric_radius_1.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between adjacent lower and higher cost cells.

symmetric_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally across one- and two-cell errors in either direction.

underestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell underestimation.

limitations: Clopper-Pearson treats each aggregate E83 cell as binomial; heterogeneous simulation strata and shared paths across cells are not modeled.
The simultaneous rectangular confidence set ignores cross-cell dependence and is therefore conservative when the marginal interval model is appropriate.
Replication multipliers scale successes and trials at unchanged empirical rates; they are planning sensitivity, not observed additional paths.
The audit holds traffic prevalence and cost-estimator confusion fixed and studies uncertainty only in E83 slower-event probabilities.
The audit is local statistical analysis and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Treat each of E83's 72 slower-event aggregates as a binomial risk cell. Construct simultaneous Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson intervals and maximize the point-selected policy's true regret over the resulting rectangular confidence set. Integer replication multipliers are unchanged-rate planning sensitivity, not new evidence.
